recent_features.name: Interactive Configuration UI
recent_features.description: Implemented an interactive UI for configuring model parameters with hardware-specific presets and memory usage estimation.

recent_features.name: Metrics Dashboard
recent_features.description: Created a comprehensive metrics dashboard for visualizing memory usage, model quality metrics, and advanced features performance.

recent_features.name: Memory-Efficient MoE Implementation
recent_features.description: Implemented a memory-efficient Mixture of Experts model with dynamic expert routing, CPU offloading, and gradient checkpointing.

recent_features.name: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) Support
recent_features.description: Added support for Low-Rank Adaptation with configurable rank, selective layer targeting, and weight merging utilities.

upcoming_features.name: Expert Visualization for MoE
upcoming_features.description: Add interactive visualization of expert utilization and routing patterns in MoE models.

upcoming_features.name: Hardware-Specific Optimization Profiles
upcoming_features.description: Create pre-configured optimization profiles for different hardware targets (consumer GPUs, server GPUs, CPU-only).

upcoming_features.name: Export/Import Configuration Settings
upcoming_features.description: Add ability to export and import configuration settings between different environments.

documentation_updates.changes: Added documentation for interactive configuration UI, metrics dashboard, and advanced features support.
